TABLE.NAME: filter_bunkercast_embed
TABLE.COMMENT: Videos authorised for playback in a course or activity. One row per (context, video). Holds no user data and no playback credential: it records that somebody who could publish in that place chose that video.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course or activity context the video is authorised in

KEY.NAME: contextidfileid
KEY.COMMENT: Authorising twice is a no-op, not a duplicate row
